name: get_project_domain
description:
Get project domain by project id/name and domain name.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v9/projects/{idOrName}/domains/{domain} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
